scope: Options-only Retry focus, duplicate suppression and stale options/session receipt guards; Q06 remains Review

environment.renderer: One final production renderer/preload for all 22 final projections
environment.main: Copied instrumented main/storage from playlist/player fixture; not unmodified current production main
environment.storage: Actual options/session writes in disposable safeStorage/local state, seeded failed restore; placeholder readiness keys, null shared-key adapter, stopped scheduler
environment.media: Muted; options-only checks restore no song; session cases explicitly restore paused queue
environment.faults: Hold before operation for repeat/failure/success; hold-after actual operation for delayed receipt versus newer edit/session result
environment.processes: Five observer reports terminal without page errors, including one readiness-only run before lint-only source correction; owned localhost catalog terminal exit143

review.Steve: Support after verifying main storage enqueue order and withdrawing unreachable account-ref reuse concern because App keys remount provider
review.Elena: Accept with reservation: failed-save warning remains during a newer edit until matching save confirms success; coordinator retained conservative existing warning
review.decision: Reuse existing focus helper and options API; no new main revision protocol because both writes enqueue synchronously before await

fixturePhaseLimits: Baseline bootstrap hash was not retained before adding hold-after; final basic and selective-ID bootstrap hashes are retained
session-matching-save-recovery released a batch containing a current save as well as older receipts; it does not isolate the stale guard
order-old-success-ignored selectively releases only the receipt IDs captured before the newer failed Retry; later matching session receipts are released separately

checks.fullESLint: passed after destructuring focus hook return

limitations: No new account-switch/restart native replay; keyed remount and persistence contracts reviewed in source
No forced window-loss, new overlay, same-values rapid edit, simultaneous fresh Retry before old receipt releases or false-return IPC replay
Options full-save overlap is verified through older/newer receipt order; exact every-5-second dispatch timing varies
No successful authentication handoff or complete current-control/Q06 reconciliation
No unit, VoiceOver, listener, audible/live-provider/server, OS fault or platform matrix acceptance; deferred viewport/zoom untouched
